item.title: ONE TO WATCH: McCoy Moore
item.description: If modern country is at its best when vulnerability meets grit, McCoy Moore is an artist quietly getting it exactly right. The rising Nashville-based singer-songwriter is already making waves in the UK and Europe, having just been announced as a performer on one of the festival stages at Country to Country (C2C) this March, alongside a special appearance on the Bluebird Cafe Stage for a seated songwriters’ round at the O2 Blueroom, a setting perfectly suited to his story-first songwriting.
